2014_spells.dissonant-whispers.descripti: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as it can away from you by the safest available route. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away.
2014_spells.dissonant-whispers.effectSum: Deal 3d6 psychic damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.dissonant-whispers.fullDescr: Using 1 action, you whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as it can away from you by the safest available route; The target must make a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
